Long March family — China Aerospace Science and Technology
China's GTO workhorse — Chang'e lunar landers + most Chinese comsats

Three-stage liquid-hypergolic launcher (UDMH/N2O4 on the lower stages, LH2/LOX on the third) with four side-mounted strap-on boosters. Lifts ~11 t to LEO / ~5.1 t to GTO from Xichang Satellite Launch Centre. The maiden flight (1996-02-15, Intelsat 708) failed catastrophically due to a guidance-loop fault and killed villagers downrange; the redesigned vehicle has since flown well over 100 successful missions and is the standard launcher for Chang'e lunar exploration.
